sources.title: 26.19 ✅ BEST TWITCH GUIDE ☑️ Best Twitch Build for AP & AD
Enyo Pieck's Twitch guide for Smarter Gameplay for Patch 11

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.text: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.text: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

spells.name: Venom Cask
spells.text: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

spells.name: Contaminate
spells.text: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.text: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

damage.value: Twitch deals sustained auto-attack and poison damage before finishing with E.

archetype.value: Twitch is an ADC who relies on attack speed and sustained damage.

axis.value: Twitch looks for all-ins while controlling lane-bush vision and deciding whether Q is needed to escape.

winCondition.value: Twitch wins fights by dealing sustained damage while staying at maximum range when necessary.

spikes.why: Twitch’s sustained damage is strongest with Lethal Tempo.
Twitch gains bonus AD that strengthens Contaminate in fights.

bait.why: Twitch loses his stated escape option when he spends Q to engage.
Twitch loses his stated finishing move when he spends E before building poison stacks.

mistakes.value: Twitch gives up potential E damage by using it before applying more poison stacks.
Twitch risks a gank by pushing before taking a few seconds to ward.
